WITH per_media_type AS (
  SELECT
    mt.Name AS media_type_name,
    AVG(t.UnitPrice) AS avg_list_price_per_track,
    AVG(1.0 * t.Bytes / t.Milliseconds) AS avg_size_per_millisecond
  FROM Track AS t
  JOIN MediaType AS mt ON mt.MediaTypeId = t.MediaTypeId
  WHERE t.Bytes >= 10323804
  GROUP BY mt.Name
), with_overall AS (
  SELECT
    media_type_name,
    avg_list_price_per_track,
    avg_size_per_millisecond,
    AVG(avg_size_per_millisecond) OVER () AS across_media_type_average
  FROM per_media_type
)
SELECT
  media_type_name,
  avg_list_price_per_track,
  avg_size_per_millisecond,
  avg_size_per_millisecond / across_media_type_average AS relative_avg_size_per_millisecond
FROM with_overall
WHERE across_media_type_average IS NOT NULL;

assumptions.assumption: The threshold keeps tracks whose Bytes value is at least 10,323,804; averages ignore NULL inputs, and the across-media-type average gives each grouped media type equal weight.
